title: The lane lint reads UNKNOWN on a ready PR, so no combined PR can be lint-checked while it is ready
why:
A combined PR cannot pass lane lint once it is marked ready, so it merges on an unknown, as #3292 did.

[01:03 CST Nov 16, triage] Coordinator relay 01:01 CST: PR #2860's lane lint reads UNKNOWN because main's bin/ci-job cannot read the draft flag in an `if:` (step "Wake the batch runner (red job)"); the fix (ce9db4590, red then green) adds that reader, so the lint cannot pass until it merges. The consultant says the route is `merge --lane-lint 2860 --lint-unknown-ok "<reason>"` and that he uses that flag on every lint tonight; runner 10 and the lane refuse it without the owner's own word. Page item pr-2860-lint-unknown-flag filed for the owner (a: grant the flag once; b: the consultant ships the reader as a separate small PR first, the coordinator's recommendation; c: leave #2860 parked). Separate note, no page question filed (the owner already said on an earlier lint-flag item that repeat asks are unwelcome): the consultant uses --lint-unknown-ok on his own lints tonight; the owner's 21:01 CST Nov 13 answer a covers only the five child repos. Not owner-typed.
